bioconda.name: lifton
bioconda.summary: Accurate homology-based genome-annotation lift-over combining DNA and protein alignment
bioconda.description:
LiftOn is a homology-based genome-annotation lift-over tool. Given a reference
genome and its annotation plus a target genome, it produces an annotation for
the target by combining DNA-level alignment (Liftoff / minimap2) with
protein-level alignment (miniprot) via a protein-maximization CDS-chaining
algorithm and an ORF-rescue pass. It also ships a standalone GFF3 validator
(gff3-validate).

commands: python -c "from lifton.native_bindings import is_mappy_available; assert is_mappy_available()"
